using namespace std;

long long solve(long long n) {
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    long long k = 0, cnt = 0;
    while (k * 10 + 1 <= n) {
        k = k * 10 + 1;
        ++cnt;
    }
    long long left = cnt * (n / k) + solve(n % k);
    long long m = 10 * k + 1 - n;
    long long right = cnt + 1 + cnt * (m / k) + solve(m % k);
    return left < right ? left : right;
}

    assert(freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout));
#endif
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    cout << solve(n);
    return 0;
}

long long calc(long long n) {
    struct Frame {
        long long value;
        int state;
        long long k;
        long long digits;
        long long left;
        long long right;
    };
    stack<Frame> st;
    st.push(Frame{n, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0});
    long long ret = 0;

    while (!st.empty()) {
        Frame &cur = st.top();
        if (cur.state == 0) {
            if (cur.value == 0) {
                ret = 0;
                st.pop();
                continue;
            }
            cur.k = 0;
            cur.digits = 0;
            while (cur.k * 10 + 1 <= cur.value) {
                cur.k = cur.k * 10 + 1;
                ++cur.digits;
            }
            cur.left = cur.digits * (cur.value / cur.k);
            cur.state = 1;
            st.push(Frame{cur.value % cur.k, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0});
        } else if (cur.state == 1) {
            cur.left += ret;
            long long other = 10 * cur.k + 1 - cur.value;
            cur.right = cur.digits + 1 + cur.digits * (other / cur.k);
            cur.state = 2;
            st.push(Frame{other % cur.k, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0});
        } else {
            cur.right += ret;
            ret = cur.left < cur.right ? cur.left : cur.right;
            st.pop();
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

#endif

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll calc(ll n, map<ll, ll>& memo) {
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    map<ll, ll>::iterator it = memo.find(n);
    if (it != memo.end()) return it->second;

    ll k = 0;
    int digits = 0;
    while (k * 10 + 1 <= n) {
        k = k * 10 + 1;
        ++digits;
    }

    ll ans1 = digits * (n / k) + calc(n % k, memo);
    ll other = 10 * k + 1 - n;
    ll ans2 = digits + 1 + digits * (other / k) + calc(other % k, memo);
    ll ans = min(ans1, ans2);
    memo[n] = ans;
    return ans;
}

#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE

    assert(freopen("output.txt", "w", stdout));
#endif
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);

    ll n;
    cin >> n;
